t: The Golden Path: The One Bulletproof Command Layer to Rule an AI’s Shell
s: This article introduces Pipulate, an AI-augmented automation framework, and its core "aha!" moment: establishing a reliable command layer for AIs to interact with local development environments. It proposes a Model-Context-Protocol (MCP) as the structured language for AI intent, emphasizing the primacy of the command line, web browser, and XML for AI embodiment.
sub: The Three Contracts: Command Line, Browser, XML for AI embodiment
Reliable AI shell command execution despite terminal inconsistencies
AI Keychain for context and state management
